obtenu: Ned sã n paam yell n ka tõe n bao yell n yɩɩd a to, a rɩka a meng yell n tɩgdẽ.
Ned fãa gũus ne rɩɩb sẽn ya toogo.
Ned ka tõe n bao a sẽn ka paam ye.
Ned sã n ka tõe n bao yell n tɩgd yãamd, a ka tõe n bao yell n tɩgd yãamd ye.
Ned fãa gũus ne a sẽn tar yell n gũus a meng ye.
Fo sã n yɩɩd a taab n zĩ, a ka tõe n zĩ n yɩɩd f meng ye.
Ned sã n tɩgd sagb n yɩɩd a nif-be-rʋkẽ, a tõe n tɩgd sagb n yɩɩd a nif-be-rʋkẽ.
Ned sã n yã yell n ka tõe n bao a sẽn be be, a tõe n bao yell la a ka tõe n bao a sẽn be be ye.
Ned sã n dat n maan yell n na n tõeeme, a na n tõeeme.
Naab sã n tʋmdẽ, a ka tʋm n tʋmd ye.
Ned fãa gũus ne a sẽn tog n bao yell ye.
